label: end-of-episode (low value) clock, suppressed by S1 / a2 policy
explanation: Fires only in the last ~10 trials of an episode (99.8% of mass at ep_trial 90-99, none before trial 80). Over that stretch the model value head falls steadily, so value < ~4-5 is a smooth proxy for the episode end; activation grows as the episode nears its end (activations climb trial by trial inside late windows; top windows sit at the very end). Within that period it is suppressed on two kinds of step: D2 steps showing S1 (never active, 0 of 184k), and steps where the policy argmax is a2 (0.1% rate, mostly GO steps choosing a2). So it fires at D1 (63% of mass), D2 when S2 is shown, and GO when the agent is about to choose a1. It does not depend on reward history, transition type, the good state or stay/switch (all near 1x lift). Using ep_trial >= 93 instead of value gives F1 0.76 dev, value < 4 gives 0.82. All variables are observed or the model own computation (value, policy argmax); no future variables.

issues: The main claims hold. Of the active steps, 0 fall in trials 0-79 (ep_trial<80 gives F1 0). 99.8% of activation mass falls in trials 90-99. The unit is active on 0 of 183,887 in_state==1 (S1 shown at D2) steps, and model_act==2 has a 0.1% active rate (mostly GO). Phase mass is D1 0.63, GO 0.13, D2 0.24. Test F1 is 0.812 (P 0.779, R 0.847, mass 0.94), which reproduces the reported scores.

Minor overclaim: 'does not depend on reward history'. Within value<4 at D1, precision is 0.88 when in_rew==1 and 0.75 when in_rew==0, and in_rew==1 carries 42% of mass against 16%. So D1 activity is somewhat stronger after a reward. This may partly come through the value term, but it is not exactly 1x.
The GO a1 component is weaker than the D1 and D2-S2 components: (value<4)&GO&model_act==1 has precision only 0.57.

Misses (test) are low-magnitude activations around the onset boundary: coverage of the lowest activation quartile is only 0.61, against 0.99 for the top quartile. False positives also sit near the onset. This looks like threshold noise from approximating a smooth clock with value<4, not a systematic class. Variants (value<4.2, adding ep_trial>=88, or adding a reward-gated D1 term) do not improve F1 (0.806, 0.817, 0.774).
